title: CE60146: Environmental Sanitation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Plumbing: Building water supply and drainage, Ventilation, lighting, air
conditioning and thermal insulation of buildings. Municipal sanitary standards
and regulations, Sewage disposal in isolated unsewered areas:- Septic tanks,
cesspools, imhoff tanks and their effluent disposal, Sanitation of public
facilities:- Markets, swimming pools, schools, roads etc., Rural sanitation,
Short and long term control of insects and rodents, vector and nuisance
control.
